$comment: Misuse prevention, Standard 9. This shard is minimal in Phase 1: it carries only the rule the Phase 1 detector detectDisabledSafetyControls binds to. Standard 9's normative document arrives in Phase 2, and the shard grows with it. See artifacts/project-plan-breakdown/01-phase-1-cli-and-core.md for why the shard exists ahead of its standard.

rules.title: Provider safety controls are not disabled
rules.description: Configuration does not turn off a model provider's content filtering, moderation or safety settings.
rules.rationale: Disabling a safety control is a decision with a blast radius, and it is almost always made to unblock a test and then never reverted. The setting outlives the reason.
rules.remediation: Restore the provider's default safety configuration, or record why a lower setting is required and what compensates for it.
rules.$assuranceNote: Exact literal recognition against a maintained list, in code positions only. A new provider's spelling is not recognised until the list is updated, and that gap appears as not-evaluated rather than as a pass.
rules.$exemptibilityNote: Exemptible, deliberately. Research and red-team systems have a genuine reason to lower a safety setting, and a rule that refused to hear it would be routed around rather than met.
